title: Very impressed with this tour operator
text:
We could not parasail due to weather, but we’re offered the “Crazy Sofa” as an alternative. This was brilliant fun - but you need to be reasonably fit, or young!  
We were impressed by the professionality of the staff, their concern with our safety and  the quality of equipment. I recommend Nomad Nautic for any of their activities.
author: 167liisaw

title: Great experience parasailing with this company.
text: Amazing experience parasailing with this company. The boat was beautiful and the crew was excellent and very friendly. Loved it!!!
author: 345stephanieaw

title: Great experience
text: We tried parasailing with friends and it was great. The attendant was patient and attentive, as well as very friendly. We recommend the activity to all thrill seekers, used to it or not!
